name: codex-task-notifier
description: Send completed Codex task notifications with an optional privacy mode.

interface.shortDescription: Forward task completions with optional local redaction.
interface.longDescription: Posts Codex completion and session-activity events to one machine-specific webhook URL. Normal-mode configurations can optionally run a manually started bridge for mobile follow-up tasks; privacy mode remains notification-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Configure or test my Codex task notification webhook.
